steps.name: mark_completed_without_vector

steps.name: finalize_file

steps.name: mark_failed

steps.name: non_admin_not_found

steps.claim: The endpoint selects unrestricted file lookup for admin and user-scoped lookup for every non-admin role admitted by the dependency.

steps.name: lookup_any_file

steps.name: admin_file_present

steps.name: user_process

steps.name: resolved_collection_name

steps.name: resolved_collection_name
